title_sq: SHITET SHTEPI PRIVATE 2 KATESHE PAZARI I RI
description_sq:
Shitet Shtepi e Private e vjeter Tiranase, 2 Kateshe ne Pazarin e Ri, rruga “Qemal Stafa” shume prane Qendres se Tiranes.
*Trualli 150 m2
*Nr i kateve 2.
*Baza e ndertimit 120 m2.
*Trualli i lire 30 m2 i cili sherben edhe si oborr i shtepise.
*Siperfaqia e katit te pare 120 m2, eshte organizuar ne :
Holl qe sherben si sallon pritje, soxhorno ndenje, dhome gatimi, ngrenie dhe ndenje, dhome gjumi, tualet.
*Siperfaqia e katit te 2-te 120 m2, nga te cilat 60 m2 jane siperfaqe te brendeshme, eshte organizuar ne : sallon, 1 dhome gjumi, dhome e vogel ndenje oxhaku tradicional tiranase, tualet.
60 m2 eshte nje verante e hapur ne natyre qe komunikon me sallonin.
*Siperfaqia totale e ndertimit:
240 m2
*Eshte e rrethuar me mur dhe porte me vete.
*Vend shume i qete.
*I pershtateshem per banim.
*Nqs do te perdoret per banim, ka nevoje per rikinstruksion total.
*Eshte i pershtateshem edhe per ndertim pallati duke u bashkuar me fqinjet.
Cmimi *300.000 €uro
title_en: PRIVATE 2-STOREY HOUSE FOR SALE, PAZARI NEW
description_en: Old Tirana Private House for sale, 2 floors in Pazarin e Ri, "Qemal Stafa" street, very close to the Center of Tirana. *Plot 150 m2 *Number of floors 2. *Construction base 120 m2. * Vacant plot of 30 m2, which also serves as a yard. *The surface of the first floor is 120 m2, it is organized in: Hall that serves as a reception hall, living room, kitchen, dining and living room, bedroom, toilet. *The surface of the 2nd floor is 120 m2, of which 60 m2 is internal surface, is organized in: living room, 1 bedroom, small living room with traditional Tirana fireplace, toilet. 60 m2 is a summerhouse open in nature that communicates with the living room. *Total construction area: 240 m2 *It is surrounded by a wall and its own gate. *Very quiet place. *Suitable for habitation. *If it will be used for housing, it needs total reconstruction. *It is also suitable for the construction of a building joining the neighbors. Price *€300,000
